preview.summary: Audit complete (mock). Score 78/100. 3 high-impact fixes identified.

topFixes.title: Add meta description
topFixes.why: Drives click-through rate from search results.
steps: Add a <meta name="description" content="..."> of 140-160 characters.
topFixes.example: Example: "Discover handcrafted leather backpacks — free EU shipping on orders over €60."

topFixes.title: Optimize images
topFixes.why: Large images slow LCP and hurt mobile rankings.
steps: Compress images >200KB with mozjpeg or webp.

topFixes.title: Add H1 on homepage
topFixes.why: Helps search engines and users understand the page topic.
steps: Add exactly one <h1> above the main content.
